messages:
kai_sales: Quick thread — Beacon wants to add a Luxembourg subsidiary as a signer on the order form, add a one-line AML/sanctions screening clause to the MSA, and have AP + legal sign. Any blockers?

beth_legal: We can do a short addendum enumerating signing entities and scoped AML (screening only). Need exact legal name + VAT/EIN. Will avoid adding new indemnities. Also prefer order form to reference the addendum.

omar_finance: Finance requires a PO before provisioning seats. Default Net30; customer asked Net60. We can consider Net60 pending credit, or Net30 with 1% early-pay credit. Need billing contact + remit.

lee_eng: Tech gating: Dedicated POC provisioning requires the DPA to include the new subsidiary before we hand over VPN or console creds. That's non-negotiable.

maya_cs: Customer prefers internal HSM signing but can accept DocuSign today if we add a migration clause to HSM later. Do we support that?

beth_legal: Yes: "Interim DocuSign permitted; parties may migrate to HSM-backed signing upon mutual written agreement without changing effective date." I'll draft addendum + DPA update.

kai_sales: I'll get legal name + VAT and billing contact from buyer. Meanwhile please queue a DocuSign envelope as interim.

esign-bot: created envelope env-1799-beacon-order (DocuSign) awaiting signatures.

maya_cs: Beacon replied: "Beacon Luxembourg S.a.r.l." VAT LU12345678. Billing contact invoices@beacon.example.lu.

beth_legal: Thanks. Drafting addendum now; will include signing matrix mapping signer -> invoicing entity -> data processing scope.

omar_finance: Confirming PO required field and route to invoices@beacon.example.lu. Holding provisioning until signed DPA + order form.

kai_sales: plan: hold POC activation until signed order form + DPA. Can run internal preflight while legal drafts. Thanks all.
